meta.name: Post daily LinkedIn and Instagram content with Airtable, Claude, OpenAI and Buffer

name: Daily AI Social Post — Airtable + Claude + AI Image + Buffer

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger Posts
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 08:00 (workflow timezone). Change the hour/interval here to adjust your posting rhythm.

nodes.name: Get Post Ideas
nodes.notes: Reads every row from the 'Topics' table where Active = TRUE. This is your idea bank: one topic per row in a field called 'Topic'.

nodes.name: Check History Posts
nodes.notes: Fetches the last 14 published posts (sorted by Date, newest first). Used to avoid repeating a topic too soon. 'Always output data' is ON so an empty table does not stop the run.

nodes.name: Filter and Choose Post Topic
nodes.notes: Compares the idea bank against the last 14 published posts, keeps only the topics that were NOT used recently and picks one at random. Outputs { topic, isValid }.

nodes.name: Is Valid Post?
nodes.notes: TRUE branch = a fresh topic was found, continue. FALSE branch = every topic was already used in the last 14 runs, stop safely.

nodes.name: No Operation, do nothing
nodes.notes: Dead end on purpose: nothing is published when no fresh topic is available. Add more rows to the Topics table (or a Slack/Email node here) if you want an alert.

nodes.name: Claude - Write Post Text
nodes.notes: Calls the Anthropic Messages API and writes the caption for the chosen topic. EDIT THE PROMPT INSIDE THE JSON BODY: replace the brand context, tone of voice and rules with your own.

nodes.name: Put Text in Variable
nodes.notes: Extracts the plain text out of the Anthropic API response and stores it as 'postText', so later nodes can reference it cleanly.

nodes.name: ChatGPT - Generate Image
nodes.notes: Generates a 1024x1024 branded illustration with the OpenAI image API. The prompt reuses the chosen topic and the generated caption, so image and text always match. Edit the style/colours in the prompt.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
=A professional, modern SaaS vector illustration for a tech company named 'Kijkes', which provides automated, lightning-fast website creation and online tools for Belgian small businesses.

CORE CONCEPT:
Kijkes is about fast, hassle-free web delivery, launching offline companies online instantly, and providing automated growth tools (like Google Business and automated reviews).

THEME & TEXT INCLUSION:
The main subject of this post is: "{{ $node["Is Valid Post?"].json.topic }}".
Inside the image, clearly and cleanly render one logical, highly relevant Dutch word integrated into the design (for example: "ONLINE!", "KIJKES", "SNEL", or "WEBSITE"). Ensure perfect typography and correct spelling.

INSPIRATION FROM CONTENT:
Use the specific theme of this text to shape the main object of the illustration:
"{{ $json.postText }}"

COLOR PALETTE (Mandatory):
- Main Color: #6c54f7 (Vibrant Purple)
- Secondary Color: #b8affa (Soft Lavender-grey)
- Accents: Deep Charcoal/Black and Pure White

STYLE DETAILS:
- Clean 2D vector art with smooth, modern gradients.
- Visually dynamic: Create a central, recognizable metaphor for speed, instant automation, and hassle-free web creation (like a website popping up instantly out of a clean box, a digital dashboard launching, or a fast automated setup).
- Constraints: White background only. No photorealism. No corporate logos. No random gibberish text.

nodes.name: Base64 to PNG
nodes.notes: The image API returns base64. This node converts data[0].b64_json into a real binary PNG file so it can be uploaded.

nodes.name: Upload Post to ImgBB
nodes.notes: Social APIs need a public image URL, not a file. ImgBB hosts the PNG and returns that URL. Paste your own free ImgBB API key in the 'key' query parameter (or swap this node for S3 / Cloudinary / Drive).

nodes.name: Create LinkedIn Post
nodes.notes: Sends caption + image URL to Buffer for the LinkedIn channel. Fill in your own Buffer organization ID and channel ID.

nodes.name: Create Instagram Post
nodes.notes: Sends the same caption + image URL to Buffer for the Instagram channel. Fill in your own Buffer organization ID and channel ID.

nodes.name: Log Posted Content
nodes.notes: Writes topic, caption and image URL to the 'Posts' table. This is what makes the 14-day anti-repeat memory work, so do not remove it.

parameters.content:
## 1. Pick a fresh topic
Loads your active topics and the last 14 published posts, then randomly picks one that was not used recently. If every topic has been used, the run stops instead of repeating itself.

## 2. Generate the content
Claude writes the caption, OpenAI illustrates it, and the base64 response is converted into a real PNG file.

## 3. Publish and remember
ImgBB turns the PNG into a public URL, Buffer schedules it on LinkedIn and Instagram, and Airtable logs it as tomorrow's memory.

## 🗂️ Airtable setup

Create one base with these tables. Both the daily-post and the weekly-video version of this workflow can share the same base.

**Topics** — your idea bank
| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `Topic` | Single line text |
| `Active` | Checkbox |

Only checked rows are used. Fill it with 20-40 ideas; the workflow picks one at random per run.

**Posts** — the history it remembers
| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `Date` | Created time |
| `Topic` | Single line text |
| `Post` | Long text |
| `Image URL` | URL |

⚠️ `Date` must be a **Created time** field, not a normal date. The workflow never writes it, but it sorts on it to find the last 14 items. Without it the anti-repeat check silently breaks.

**How the anti-repeat works:** active topics minus the last 14 logged rows = the pool it picks from. Empty pool means the run stops instead of repeating content, so keep 15+ topics active.

Posts and reels use separate history tables, so the same topic can run as an image post and as a video without blocking each other.

## 📅 Daily AI Social Post Engine

Every morning this workflow picks a topic it has not used recently, writes the caption with Claude, generates a matching AI image, and schedules it to LinkedIn and Instagram through Buffer.

### How it works
1. The schedule trigger fires daily at 08:00.
2. Airtable returns your active topics plus the last 14 published posts.
3. A Code node randomly picks a topic that is not in that history, so content never repeats.
4. Claude writes the caption, then OpenAI generates an image from that same caption so text and visual always match.
5. The base64 image becomes a real PNG, ImgBB hosts it and returns the public URL the social APIs require.
6. Buffer schedules the post and Airtable logs it as tomorrow's memory.

### Setup
1. Create credentials for Airtable, Anthropic, OpenAI and Buffer.
2. Build the Airtable base described in the grey note below this one.
3. Add a free ImgBB API key, then pick your organization and channel in both Buffer nodes.
4. Keep at least 15 active topics, otherwise the workflow stops instead of repeating itself.

### Customization
Edit the Claude prompt for your tone of voice and the image prompt for your brand style. Swap ImgBB for S3, Drive or Cloudinary if you prefer.
